Procedure details: procedure_details: "3,5-dibromopyridine (1.233 g, 5.20 mmol), 1-(piperazin-1-yl)ethanone (0.734 g, 5.73 mmol), PdOAc2 (0.117 g, 0.52 mmol), XANTPHOS (0.361 g, 0.62 mmol), Cs2CO3 (5.09 g, 15.61 mmol), 1,4-dioxane as added to a 10 mL microwave vial.
